title: Union with Christ
definition: Union with Christ is the believer's saving relationship with Jesus in which they are joined to Him and share in the benefits of His life, death, resurrection, and reign.
summary: Believers are united to Christ and receive every saving blessing in Him.
christFocus: Christ is not only the giver of salvation; He is the One to whom believers are joined by faith.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Union with Christ is central to salvation. Believers are chosen in Christ, justified in Christ, sanctified in Christ, raised with Christ, and kept in Christ.

This union is received by faith and worked by the Spirit. It means salvation is not detached benefits handed out apart from Jesus; every blessing comes in Him.

Union with Christ gives identity, security, holiness, and hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people think of salvation only as forgiveness or future heaven. Union with Christ matters because it shows that the believer's whole life is joined to Jesus.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Find your identity in Christ. Remember that your old life has been crucified with Him and your new life is hidden with Him.
